notes: Fixes the evaluator-reported contract failure: schema.json keys `dense_columns`, `categorical_columns` and `label_column` are now honored exactly (case-insensitive, with aliases), so the first 13 features are the standardized I1..I13 numerics and the next 26 are the C1..C26 categorical ids. Standardization uses the training mean and training population std (ddof=0, std==0 -> 1); missing numerics are filled with 0; category dictionaries are lexicographically sorted with ids from 1 and 0 for missing/unknown. All numeric statistics, standardization and final float32 (N,39) tensor assembly run on cuda:0 with torch.cuda.synchronize() around GPU sections; CUDA is mandatory. `validation_labels.npy` is now written ONLY when the validation JSONL actually carries labels — otherwise it is omitted and reported as unavailable (never fabricated). `transform --preprocessor PATH --input JSONL --output NPY` still reloads the persisted state and reapplies the identical mapping. `doctor --input input` inspects required files and dependencies without training, lists every missing item and returns 78 if any is missing, 0 otherwise; `--help` never imports torch.
